# Staff Outsourcing

> Dutch staffing and recruitment company helping Netherlands-based businesses hire EU talent through two employer models: Payrolling (Staff Outsourcing is the legal employer, client leases the staff member) and RPO/Recruitment (Staff Outsourcing sources and screens candidates who join the client's own payroll directly). Focused on IT, digital, admin, finance, and travel roles across the Netherlands and EU.

## Company

- [Home](https://www.staffoutsourcing.nl/): Overview of the two hiring models (Payrolling and RPO), how the process works, and industries served
- [About Us](https://www.staffoutsourcing.nl/over-ons): Company background and approach
- [Our Approach](https://www.staffoutsourcing.nl/onze-aanpak): How Staff Outsourcing works with clients
- [Contact](https://www.staffoutsourcing.nl/neem-contact-op): Enquiry form for hiring companies and job seekers, contact details

## Hiring Models

- [Recruitment / Werving & Selectie](https://www.staffoutsourcing.nl/werving-selectie): One-off direct hire recruitment — candidate joins client's own payroll from day one
- [Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO)](https://www.staffoutsourcing.nl/rpo-wervingsproces-uitbesteding): Ongoing recruitment for multiple roles, embedded in the client's hiring calendar
- [Temporary Staffing / Uitzendwerk](https://www.staffoutsourcing.nl/uitzendwerk): Staff Outsourcing acts as legal employer (contracts, salary, tax, Dutch labor law) for short- to medium-term needs
- [Payrolling](https://www.staffoutsourcing.nl/payrolling): Client has already found a candidate; Staff Outsourcing becomes the legal employer on paper while the person works exclusively for the client

## Roles We Place

- [IT & Development](https://www.staffoutsourcing.nl/it-ontwikkeling): Full Stack, Front-End, Back-End, App (iOS/Android), Data Engineer, AI/ML Engineer, QA Tester, Remote IT Support, Electrical Engineer
- [Design Services](https://www.staffoutsourcing.nl/ontwerpdiensten): Web Designer/Developer, Graphic Designer
- [Marketing & Analytics](https://www.staffoutsourcing.nl/marketing-analyse): Social Media Manager, Content Creator/Copywriter, Online Marketer, Google Analytics Specialist, Power BI Specialist, Data Analyst
- [Admin & Business Support](https://www.staffoutsourcing.nl/administratie-bedrijfsondersteuning): Virtual Assistant, Ecommerce Webshop Assistant, Remote Customer Service, Data Entry Specialist, Remote HR Assistant, Client Relationship Manager
- [Finance & Accounting](https://www.staffoutsourcing.nl/financien-boekhouding): Accountant/Financial Assistant, Administrative Bookkeeping Assistant, Excel Specialist
- [Travel & Reservations](https://www.staffoutsourcing.nl/reizen-reserveringen): Online Travel Advisor, Reservations Employee, Travel Agency Customer Service, Travel Marketer
